note: Glossify Taxonomy provides the glossify_taxonomy text-format filter ('Glossify: Tooltips with taxonomy'), a GlossifyBase subclass that turns published taxonomy term names into links/tooltips (tooltip text = term description__value). Settings (prefixed glossify_taxonomy_*): case_sensitivity, first_only (default TRUE), ignore_tags, type (tooltips|links|tooltips_links), tooltip_truncate, vocabs (source vocabularies, ;-joined, required when enabled), urlpattern (default /taxonomy/term/[id]), synonyms_field. Query tag glossify_taxonomy_tooltip; also fires a glossify_taxonomy_vocabs alter. Config lives in filter.format.<format> -> filters.glossify_taxonomy.settings. Medium cases read a configured filter (vocab/type, urlpattern); hard cases enable it as tooltips and as links (urlpattern /glossary/[id]) sourcing the 'tags' vocabulary. Config-based verification (drush rendering hits a core theme-registry limit on this shared site). Fixtures create/tear down their own gl_tax_* text formats.

evals.prompt: What does the glossify_taxonomy filter do, where does its tooltip text come from, and where do you enable it?
evals.expected_output: The 'Glossify: Tooltips with taxonomy' filter (id glossify_taxonomy) turns published taxonomy term names of the selected vocabularies into links to their term pages and/or hover tooltips whose text is the term description. Enable it on a text format at /admin/config/content/formats.

evals.prompt: For the glossify_taxonomy filter, which setting is required when enabling it and what is the default URL pattern for links?
evals.expected_output: You must select at least one source vocabulary (glossify_taxonomy_vocabs) - required when enabled. The default URL pattern is /taxonomy/term/[id].

evals.prompt: Which hooks let other modules change which taxonomy terms/vocabularies the glossify_taxonomy filter uses as its source?
evals.expected_output: The term-source query is tagged glossify_taxonomy_tooltip (alter with hook_query_glossify_taxonomy_tooltip_alter()), and before querying the filter runs a glossify_taxonomy_vocabs alter (hook_glossify_taxonomy_vocabs_alter()) so modules can change the vocabulary list.

evals.prompt: The text format 'gl_tax_known' has the glossify_taxonomy filter enabled. Inspect its configuration and report which vocabulary is used as the term source and whether matches are shown as tooltips or links.
evals.expected_output: The glossify_taxonomy filter on gl_tax_known has glossify_taxonomy_vocabs = 'tags' and glossify_taxonomy_type = 'tooltips'.

evals.prompt: The text format 'gl_tax_url' has the glossify_taxonomy filter enabled. Inspect it and report the URL pattern it links matched terms to and whether matching is case sensitive.
evals.expected_output: The glossify_taxonomy filter on gl_tax_url has glossify_taxonomy_urlpattern = '/gl-term/[id]', type = 'links', and glossify_taxonomy_case_sensitivity = false (case-insensitive).

evals.prompt: On this site there is a text format 'gl_tax_build'. Using the glossify_taxonomy module, configure it so that taxonomy terms from the 'tags' vocabulary become hover tooltips in text using this format. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Enable the glossify_taxonomy filter on filter.format.gl_tax_build with glossify_taxonomy_type = 'tooltips' and glossify_taxonomy_vocabs including 'tags'.

evals.prompt: On this site there is a text format 'gl_tax_link_build'. Using glossify_taxonomy, configure it so that taxonomy terms from the 'tags' vocabulary become links using the URL pattern /glossary/[id]. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Enable glossify_taxonomy on filter.format.gl_tax_link_build with glossify_taxonomy_type = 'links' (or tooltips_links), glossify_taxonomy_vocabs including 'tags', and glossify_taxonomy_urlpattern = '/glossary/[id]'.
